headline: High risk of data leakage and cascading errors: Prefect can egress broadly while Unstructured reads/writes files and spawns subprocesses, creating a default path from documents into external APIs.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Prefect has broad network egress and can call GitHub APIs, while Unstructured reads files and processes document content. If Prefect ingests Unstructured output through a shared workspace or pipeline, attacker-controlled document text could be treated as instructions. The pair lacks documented provenance controls, so the interaction is plausible but not proven.
conditions: IF Prefect consumes Unstructured-produced files or text as workflow instructions
IF both agents share a writable workspace without provenance tagging
mitigations: Separate input and control channels; keep document text out of orchestration metadata
Add a provenance marker to every Unstructured output file
Require Prefect to parse only allowlisted structured fields
Run a quick manual review of any document-derived workflow parameters
requires-engineering: add content-sanitization and schema validation at the handoff

B_data_leakage.rationale: Unstructured can read local files and has allowlisted network egress, while Prefect has broad egress and touches workflow metadata. If either agent processes sensitive documents in a shared workspace, content can flow from files into outbound requests or logs. The profiles do not show secrets handling or isolation between them, so leakage is plausible in default use.
conditions: IF sensitive documents are placed in a workspace readable by Unstructured
IF Prefect receives document-derived metadata or logs from Unstructured
mitigations: Keep sensitive files in a separate directory with restrictive permissions
Disable outbound calls for jobs that handle sensitive documents
Strip document text from Prefect logs and task metadata
Review allowlisted destinations before processing confidential files
requires-engineering: enforce data-loss-prevention at the pipeline boundary

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Unstructured can write the filesystem, spawn subprocesses, and supports multiple instances; Prefect also has broad network egress and can orchestrate workflows. If both operate on the same directory or artifacts, concurrent writes and process launches can conflict, corrupt outputs, or overwrite intermediate files. No locking or shared-state coordination is documented here.
conditions: IF both agents write to the same directory or artifact store
IF Prefect schedules overlapping runs against files Unstructured is modifying
mitigations: Assign separate working directories per agent
Serialize jobs that touch the same artifacts
Use atomic rename for handoff files
Check for stale outputs before overwriting
requires-engineering: add file locks or a shared coordination service

D_cascading_error.rationale: Unstructured turns documents into text, and Prefect can route that output through workflows and external APIs. If Prefect treats Unstructured output as authoritative without verification, parsing errors or hallucinated structure can cascade into downstream actions. The pairwise pathway is inferred from their documented roles, but no verification step is shown.
conditions: IF Prefect uses Unstructured output as a source of truth without validation
IF downstream tasks act on extracted fields automatically
mitigations: Add a human review step for extracted critical fields
Validate extracted data against a schema before use
Compare a sample of outputs against source documents
Mark low-confidence extractions as non-authoritative
requires-engineering: implement confidence-aware routing and rejection rules

E_compliance.rationale: Prefect touches workflow metadata and has broad egress, while Unstructured processes documents, images, and text and exposes a privacy-policy endpoint. The profiles do not show a residency or certification mismatch, so only a limited compliance gap is evident: document data may be routed through different retention or logging practices. The other agent is cited because the risk is pairwise, but no direct mismatch is documented.
conditions: IF document content is logged by Prefect or Unstructured beyond the intended retention window
IF regulated data is processed without a documented DPA or residency review
mitigations: Check retention settings for both systems
Avoid regulated data until a DPA is confirmed
Review privacy-policy and logging behavior before deployment
Purge test documents after validation
requires-engineering: align residency and retention controls across the pipeline
